description: NAC (802.1X), micro-segmentation, and SASE — network access control, posture assessment, and zero trust enforcement.
name: Network Security & Zero Trust
quickFacts: Collect ISE/NAC RADIUS accounting logs and install Splunk_TA_cisco-ise for structured data.

useCases.title: NAC Authentication Trending
useCases.value: Authentication success/failure trends reveal infrastructure issues (certificate problems, RADIUS outages) and security events.

useCases.title: Endpoint Posture Failures
useCases.value: Non-compliant endpoints accessing the network pose security risks. Posture tracking ensures endpoint hygiene enforcement.

useCases.title: VLAN Assignment Audit
useCases.value: Dynamic VLAN assignments reflect authorization decisions. Anomalous placements may indicate policy misconfiguration or attacks.

useCases.title: Guest Network Usage
useCases.value: Guest network monitoring ensures acceptable use and identifies capacity needs. Unusual patterns may indicate abuse.

useCases.title: BYOD Onboarding Tracking
useCases.value: BYOD onboarding metrics inform mobile device management strategy and user experience optimization.

useCases.title: MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB)
useCases.value: MAB devices bypass 802.1X and rely on MAC address only. Monitoring for unauthorized MACs prevents rogue device access.

useCases.title: Profiling Accuracy
useCases.value: Accurate device profiling enables correct authorization policies. Misprofiled devices may get inappropriate access.

useCases.title: NAC Policy Change Audit
useCases.value: NAC policy changes affect network access for all devices. Unauthorized changes can create security gaps or disrupt access.

useCases.title: 802.1X Supplicant Timeout Tracking
useCases.value: Clients timing out during RADIUS authentication (common issue with Wi-Fi and wired NAC). Tracking timeouts helps identify supplicant misconfiguration, certificate issues, or network latency affecting…

useCases.title: RADIUS Accounting Discrepancies
useCases.value: Start/stop mismatches indicating dropped sessions or potential abuse. Accounting discrepancies can hide unauthorized access, session hijacking, or billing/audit gaps.

useCases.title: Posture Assessment Failure Trends
useCases.value: Time-series view of posture failures by policy and reason — distinguishes one-off issues from worsening fleet hygiene or a bad policy rollout.

useCases.title: Rogue Device Detection
useCases.value: Identifies MACs or devices that authenticate or probe but are not in the corporate device inventory — common NAC use case for unauthorized hardware.

useCases.title: 802.1X Authentication Failure Analysis
useCases.value: Breaks down 802.1X/EAP failures by method, failure reason, and NAS to pinpoint certificate rollout issues vs brute-force vs misconfigured supplicants.

useCases.title: Guest Network Abuse Detection
useCases.value: Flags excessive concurrent guest sessions, high bandwidth, or repeated sponsor abuse — beyond simple guest usage volume (UC-17.1.4).

useCases.title: RADIUS Accounting NAS vs Session-ID Reconciliation
useCases.value: Complements UC-17.1.10 by flagging duplicate session IDs or mismatched NAS-IP between Start/Interim/Stop for the same `Acct-Session-Id` — catching replication and proxy issues.

useCases.title: MAC Authentication Bypass Anomaly Detection
useCases.value: Complements UC-17.1.6 whitelist checks with **volume and velocity** anomalies (sudden MAB spikes per port or site) that may indicate MAC spoofing or policy gaps.

useCases.title: Network Quarantine Effectiveness
useCases.value: Measures how often quarantined endpoints reach compliant state (successful remediation vs repeat quarantine) — effectiveness of NAC remediation workflows.

useCases.title: NAC Policy Compliance Trending
useCases.value: Daily percentage of authentications that receive “permit” vs “deny” vs “redirect” per authorization policy — trending for policy drift and rollout validation.

useCases.title: Endpoint Compliance Scoring
useCases.value: Composite score per endpoint from posture checks (AV, patch, encryption) for executive dashboards and exception reporting.

useCases.title: Quarantine Release Audit
useCases.value: Audit trail of who released endpoints from quarantine and whether release matched policy (e.g., IT-only, ticket required).

useCases.title: ISE Endpoint Posture Compliance
useCases.value: Non-compliant endpoints (missing patches, disabled AV) on the network increase attack surface. ISE posture data enables enforcement visibility.

useCases.title: NAC Quarantine and Remediation Duration
useCases.value: Long quarantine or remediation times affect user productivity. Monitoring duration supports process improvement and exception handling.

useCases.title: VPN Concurrent Sessions
useCases.value: VPN capacity planning prevents remote workers from being locked out. Trending identifies peak usage and growth patterns.

useCases.title: VPN Authentication Failures
useCases.value: Repeated VPN auth failures indicate credential attacks against the remote access perimeter, a primary attack vector.

useCases.title: Geo-Location Anomalies
useCases.value: VPN connections from unexpected countries may indicate compromised credentials being used from attacker infrastructure.

useCases.title: Split-Tunnel Compliance
useCases.value: Split-tunnel configurations affect security visibility. Ensuring compliance with tunnel policy maintains security posture.

useCases.title: VPN Tunnel Stability
useCases.value: Frequent disconnects indicate network issues, client problems, or infrastructure instability affecting user productivity.

useCases.title: Off-Hours VPN Access
useCases.value: VPN access at unusual hours may indicate compromised credentials or unauthorized activity. Alerting supports investigation.

useCases.title: VPN Bandwidth Consumption
useCases.value: Per-user bandwidth tracking identifies heavy users, guides capacity planning, and detects potential data exfiltration.

useCases.title: Simultaneous Session Detection
useCases.value: A single user with simultaneous VPN sessions from different locations strongly indicates credential compromise.

useCases.title: VPN Split-Tunnel Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Verifying split-tunnel vs. full-tunnel adherence per user/group policy. Full-tunnel ensures all traffic is inspected; split-tunnel may bypass security controls for internet-bound traffic.

useCases.title: mTLS Certificate Rotation Tracking
useCases.value: Mutual TLS certificates approaching expiry in zero-trust architectures (service-to-service auth). Expired certs cause service outages and authentication failures.

useCases.title: Split Tunnel Violation Detection
useCases.value: Flags sessions where observed routing or client flags indicate split tunnel when group policy mandates full tunnel — complements UC-17.2.4/17.2.9 with explicit **violation** logic.

useCases.title: VPN Concentrator Capacity
useCases.value: Tracks session count and CPU/memory against platform limits to avoid remote-access brownouts during peaks.

useCases.title: Concurrent VPN Session Limits
useCases.value: Alerts when simultaneous sessions approach licensed or configured caps — same user or aggregate.

useCases.title: Geo-Impossible VPN Connections
useCases.value: Detects logins from two distant countries faster than plausible travel — complements static geo allowlists (UC-17.2.3).

useCases.title: VPN Tunnel Keepalive Failure Analysis
useCases.value: Tracks DPD/keepalive failures and tunnel teardown reasons for site-to-site and remote-access — isolates path MTU, NAT, and idle timeout issues.

useCases.title: Remote Desktop Gateway Health
useCases.value: Monitors RD Gateway (HTTP/UDP) auth success, connection failures, and capacity for hybrid workers.

useCases.title: VPN Client Version Compliance
useCases.value: Reports AnyConnect/GlobalProtect client versions against minimum supported builds.

useCases.title: Site-to-Site Tunnel Flapping
useCases.value: Counts IKE/IPsec up/down events per peer for unstable WAN or crypto issues.

useCases.title: Always-On VPN Enforcement
useCases.value: Identifies corporate assets connecting without Always-On (pre-login) VPN when policy requires it.

useCases.title: VPN Bandwidth Utilization Trending
useCases.value: Time-series bandwidth per headend and user cohort — complements UC-17.2.7 top talkers with **trend** and **gateway** dimension.

useCases.title: SSL VPN Certificate Compliance
useCases.value: Tracks server certificate expiry and chain errors on SSL VPN / GlobalProtect portals from TLS handshake logs.

useCases.title: Remote Session Duration Anomalies
useCases.value: Statistical outliers in VPN session length — unusually short (brute probe) or long (unattended tunnel) vs UC-17.3.8 fixed thresholds.

useCases.title: VPN Session Duration and Idle Timeout
useCases.value: Anomalously long or short VPN sessions may indicate abuse or connectivity issues. Monitoring supports policy tuning and security review.

useCases.title: Conditional Access Enforcement
useCases.value: A spike in policy blocks for a single application after a policy publish suggests a rule-order or identity claim error. Gradual deny-rate growth across multiple apps indicates posture drift or certif…

useCases.title: Device Trust Scoring
useCases.value: Device trust scores drive access decisions in zero-trust architecture. Monitoring ensures devices maintain compliance.

useCases.title: Micro-Segmentation Audit
useCases.value: Micro-segmentation limits lateral movement. Audit logs validate policy enforcement and detect bypasses.

useCases.title: ZTNA Application Access
useCases.value: Per-application access patterns in ZTNA reveal usage trends, security risks, and application performance issues.

useCases.title: Posture Assessment Trending
useCases.value: Endpoint posture compliance rates over time measure security improvement and identify persistent non-compliance areas.

useCases.title: Policy Drift Detection
useCases.value: Zero-trust policies require continuous validation. Drift from baseline configuration introduces security gaps.

useCases.title: Device Certificate Expiration and Renewal
useCases.value: Expired device certificates break ZTNA and VPN access. Monitoring expiration and renewal success ensures continuous access and avoids outages.

useCases.title: Zero Trust Access Denial Trending
useCases.value: High denial rates may indicate policy misconfiguration or attacker probing. Trending supports tuning and security analysis.

useCases.title: Micro-Segment Traffic Baseline Anomaly
useCases.value: New or unexpected traffic between segments may indicate lateral movement or misconfiguration. Anomaly detection supports Zero Trust enforcement.

useCases.title: Zscaler ZIA Policy Violation Trends
useCases.value: Time-series of blocked violations per URL category and rule — tunes SWG policy and spots sudden policy drift.

useCases.title: ZPA Application Segment Health
useCases.value: Tracks connector health, app segment reachability, and error rates for ZPA-published apps.

useCases.title: Cisco Umbrella DNS Block Analysis
useCases.value: Top blocked domains, identities, and policy hits for DNS-layer security tuning and threat hunting.

useCases.title: SASE Tunnel Health
useCases.value: Monitors IPSec/GRE/SSL tunnels from branch to SASE PoPs — packet loss, latency, and down events.

useCases.title: Identity-Aware Proxy Access Anomalies
useCases.value: Baselines per-user access to internal apps via IAP/ZTNA; flags new apps, odd hours, or geos.

useCases.title: Microsegmentation Policy Effectiveness
useCases.value: Ratio of expected denies vs allows for critical segments — validates that “default deny” is actually enforced.

useCases.title: Device Trust Score Trending
useCases.value: Fleet-level and cohort trend of device trust scores — extends point-in-time UC-17.3.2.

useCases.title: Continuous Authentication Compliance
useCases.value: Tracks step-up auth, re-auth, and session risk evaluation outcomes for policies requiring continuous verification.

useCases.title: Browser Isolation Usage
useCases.value: Measures adoption of remote browser isolation (RBI) sessions vs direct access — for licensing and risky-site coverage.

useCases.title: SWG Bypass Attempt Detection
useCases.value: Detects attempts to reach direct IPs, misuse PAC files, or tunnel out of SWG inspection.

useCases.title: ZTNA Application Access Latency
useCases.value: p95 latency per published application for user experience SLAs on ZTNA paths.

useCases.title: Prisma Access Tunnel Health
useCases.value: IPSec/SSL tunnel state, latency, and error codes for Palo Alto Prisma Access remote networks and mobile users.

useCases.title: Conditional Access Policy Enforcement (Entra ID)
useCases.value: Volume of grants vs blocks per named CA policy — complements generic UC-17.3.1 with Microsoft-specific policy dimension.
